name: Sledom za Ogonkami
source:
Syoma and Ulya meet in their own world and decide to find the way back together, to Sovyonok, to the Everlasting Summer. What will come of this, and where will this Road lead them?

[Translated from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1606348028]Steam[/url]]
